name: Design system
summary: The design system: 59 component files in packages/ui with Linear-derived tokens, light and dark modes, five colour themes, an icon package, empty-state illustrations and skeletons.

flow.label: Saved theme
flow.note: A boot script copies the saved colour theme ids from localStorage onto <html> before first paint.

flow.label: Design tokens
flow.note: globals.css resolves the neutral scale, --ln-* values and Tailwind utilities for that scheme and theme.

flow.label: UI primitives
flow.note: Radix-based components such as Button, Dialog and DropdownMenu style themselves with those utilities.

flow.label: Layout primitives
flow.note: PageHeader, ViewTabs, GroupHeader and DetailLayout give list and detail pages a fixed geometry.

flow.label: Mobile action bar
flow.note: On phones the properties panel becomes a bottom drawer and actions float in a bar above the nav.

flow.label: Skeleton sample
flow.note: While loading, a page renders the real component with sample data inside skullet's Skeleton.

features.name: Component library
features.summary: 59 component files: restyled shadcn primitives on Radix plus app-shaped pieces such as StatePill, Chip, Callout, SectionCard and the markdown editor.

features.name: Design tokens
features.summary: One stylesheet, three layers: a 12-step neutral scale and --ln-* values, shadcn aliases on top, then Tailwind utilities such as bg-shell and shadow-button.

features.name: Light, dark and colour themes
features.summary: Five themes (DiffKit, Tide, Graphite, Paper, Linear), picked separately for light and for dark. Most only move one hue and one tint variable.

features.name: List and detail layout
features.summary: PageHeader, ViewTabs and GroupHeader for list chrome; DetailLayout for a reading column beside a pinned properties panel. Row geometry lives in the dashboard.

features.name: Mobile bars and drawers
features.summary: On phones a floating bar holds a pill of secondary actions and one main action at the right; side panels open as vaul bottom drawers.

features.name: Icon package
features.summary: @diffkit/icons re-exports 98 Hugeicons names under app-friendly aliases and adds 24 files of hand-written SVG icons and logos. The library is named in one file.

features.name: Loading skeletons
features.summary: skullet draws loading placeholders from real components rendered with sample data. Bone colours are theme tokens, so every colour theme matches.
